records.title: CERT-EU Cyber Brief 26-05 — Finland MDM zero-day, France ANTS 19M identity records, Hungary ministry credential exposure
records.tldr_one_line: CERT-EU's April 2026 monthly threat brief (Cyber Brief 26-05, published 4 May 2026) documented three EU government incidents with direct relevance to Swiss public-sector defenders.

records.title: CERT-EU Threat Landscape Report 2025 — 174 threat actors vs Union entities; internet-facing exploitation dominant for second year; autonomous AI intrusion first documented
records.tldr_one_line: CERT-EU's annual Threat Landscape Report 2025 (published 2026-04-08, TLP:CLEAR) covers cyber threats against EU institutions, bodies, offices, and agencies across 2025.

records.title: Swisscom Cybersecurity Threat Radar 2026 — four strategic risk pillars for Swiss and EU organisations
records.tldr_one_line: Swisscom's annual Cybersecurity Threat Radar 2026 (published 2026-04-27) identifies four strategic risk areas directly relevant to Swiss public-sector and EU-adjacent defenders.

records.title: GitHub internal-repo breach PIR [SINGLE-SOURCE: GitHub Security Blog] — no fuller report published as of 2026-05-25 (`item:teampcp-mini-shai-hulud-campaign-github-itself-breached-micr`)
records.tldr_one_line: GitHub's 2026-05-20 initial disclosure committed to a fuller post-incident report on the ~3,800 exfiltrated internal repositories.

records.title: PAN-OS CVE-2026-0300 — wave-2 patches still pending; scheduled ~2026-05-28; CL-STA-1132 post-exploitation confirms AD enumeration via firewall service account
records.tldr_one_line: Wave-2 patches for the buffer-overflow pre-auth RCE in PAN-OS User-ID Authentication Portal / Captive Portal (CVSS 9.3) remain scheduled for 2026-05-28 as of 2026-05-25 — not yet shipped.

records.title: CVE-2026-45585 (YellowKey) — mitigation-only; no patch; June 2026 Patch Tuesday remains the expected fix (`item:windows-chaotic-eclipse-zero-day-proliferation-yellowkey-gre`)
records.tldr_one_line: The status from 2026-05-20 holds: Microsoft has published WinRE BootExecute reseal mitigation guidance but no patch.

records.title: EU cyber-attacks sanctions framework renewed until May 2027 [SINGLE-SOURCE: Digital Watch Observatory] — 19 individuals and 7 entities maintained; no new designations
records.tldr_one_line: The EU Council renewed the individual listings under its cyber-attacks sanctions regime on approximately 11 May 2026, extending them to 18 May 2027.

records.title: NCSC.ch gap: no Shai-Hulud/Megalodon advisory as of 2026-05-25
records.tldr_one_line: NCSC.ch / GovCERT.ch has published no dedicated advisory on the Shai-Hulud, Mini Shai-Hulud, or Megalodon supply-chain worm campaigns as of 2026-05-25.

records.title: NY DFS dual industry letters (21 May) — frontier AI exploit capability and geopolitical escalation define "heightened threat environment"; leading indicator for FINMA/EBA
records.tldr_one_line: The New York Department of Financial Services issued two concurrent cybersecurity industry letters on 21 May 2026, applicable to its 3,000+ regulated financial entities.
